Caline Caline CP-500 series browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal Caline CP-501 Osmium - High-Gain Distortion Published on December 4, 2023 Caline CP-500 series distortion pedal Information Caline CP-500 series Caline CP-501 Osmium High Gain Distortion Guitar Effect Pedal for Electric Guitar and Bass The Osmium High Gain Distortion is a beast of a pedal offering a range of high-gain tones that's perfect for rock, metal, thrash, djent and much more. It is based on a well-known Distortion pedal. The Caline Osmium will take you from gritty fat chugs to molten hot high-gain heaven. Controls: LEVEL Knob: Controls the speed of the effect (and pitch on settings 4 and 7) TONE Knob: Controls the overall tone of the EQ DIST Knob: Controls the amount of gain added to your signal Features: True Bypass Aluminium alloy casing Power Requirement: 9V DC center negative Current consumption: 50 mA Weight: 0.75 lb Video Date ▼▲ Maker ▼▲ Video ▼▲ Time ▼▲ 2026-08-07 TomsPedalDemos High Gain Distortion that rocks for under $30. 1:38 2022-04-11 The SuperFunAwesomeHappyTime Pedal Show!
